name: Volex plc
summary: Volex plc manufactures and sells power and connectivity in North America, Europe, and Asia. It provides integrated manufacturing services, such as high level assembly, box build, electromechanical assemblies and systems, wiring harness and cable assembly, printed circuit board assembly, video display systems, and embedded systems; electric vehicle charging solutions; copper interconnect cables and data transfer cables; and data center power cables and power cords.
